plain_description: Make your AI applications reliable and observable. Phoenix is an open-source platform that lets you trace, evaluate, and debug LLM-powered features — from chatbots to agent workflows. The big picture: ship AI with confidence by catching issues before they reach users.
technical_description: Phoenix is an open-source AI observability platform built on OpenTelemetry. It provides tracing, evaluation, experimentation, and prompt management for LLM applications. The platform ingests OpenTelemetry traces via OpenInference instrumentation, supports a REST API and GraphQL API for programmatic access, and includes a web-based UI for visualization, debugging, and prompt engineering. It supports Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go clients, integrates with major LLM providers and agent frameworks, and can be deployed locally via pip, in Docker containers, on Kubernetes with Helm, or on cloud platforms.
title: Phoenix

body: Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.
plain_description: Opik gives your team full visibility into every LLM app and AI agent you build — from first prototype to production at scale. Debug issues, run automated evaluations, and monitor performance with production-ready dashboards. Built by Comet, Apache-2.0 licensed, and free to self-host.
technical_description: Opik is an open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform for tracing, evaluating, and monitoring LLM applications and AI agents. The full-stack platform comprises a Java backend, a TypeScript React frontend, Python and TypeScript SDKs, and a REST API. It supports deep tracing of multi-step agent calls with full trace trees, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation metrics including hallucination detection, moderation, and RAG assessment, dataset and experiment management, prompt versioning with a playground, production dashboards with online evaluation rules, and CI/CD integration via PyTest. Deploy via Docker Compose for local development or Helm on Kubernetes for production. Alternatively, use the Comet.com cloud service.
title: Opik

body: 🪢 Open source AI engineering platform: LLM evals, observability, metrics, prompt management, playground, datasets. Integrates with OpenTelemetry, LangChain, OpenAI SDK, LiteLLM, and more. 🍊YC W23
plain_description: Langfuse gives you full observability into your LLM applications so you can ship faster with confidence. It helps teams collaboratively develop, monitor, evaluate, and debug AI apps with features like tracing, prompt management, evaluations, and a playground — all in one open-source platform.
technical_description: Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform that provides observability, evaluation, and prompt management for AI applications. It ingests traces via SDKs (Python, JS/TS), OpenTelemetry, and framework integrations (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, LiteLLM, Vercel AI SDK). The platform stores telemetry data in ClickHouse and PostgreSQL, exposes a comprehensive REST API with OpenAPI spec, and offers a web-based UI for inspecting traces, managing prompts, running evaluations, and iterating in a playground. Deployment supports Docker Compose, Kubernetes (Helm), and managed cloud.
title: Langfuse

body: The platform for LLM evaluations and AI agent testing
plain_description: The big picture: Ship safer AI agents without building your own testing infrastructure. Here's why it matters: LangWatch lets you run realistic agent simulations, evaluate performance, and monitor production — all in one platform, from pre-release testing to live traffic. The bottom line: Catch agent failures before they impact users, while keeping full control over cost and governance.
technical_description: LangWatch is an open-source LLM observability, evaluation, and agent testing platform. It ingests traces via OpenTelemetry/OTLP, supports offline and online evaluation pipelines, and enables agent simulations against full-stack scenarios with automated judging. The platform includes a web UI, CLI, SDKs for Python, TypeScript, and Go, and an AI Gateway that serves as an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible proxy with virtual keys, hierarchical budgets, inline guardrails, automatic fallback, and cache passthrough. Deployment options include cloud SaaS, Docker Compose, Kubernetes via Helm charts, and on-premises infrastructure. It integrates with LangChain, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, Mastra, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenTelemetry, major model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Groq, Ollama), and platforms like LangFlow, Flowise, and n8n.
title: LangWatch

body: Open-source observability for your GenAI or LLM application, based on OpenTelemetry
plain_description: OpenLLMetry gives you complete visibility into how your LLM application is performing, from prompt to response. It connects to the monitoring tools you already use — Datadog, New Relic, and 20+ others — so you don't need to learn a new platform. One line of code gets you started.
technical_description: OpenLLMetry is a set of OpenTelemetry extensions that instrument LLM applications for observability. It provides auto-instrumentation for major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.), vector databases (Chroma, Pinecone, Qdrant, etc.), and AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, etc.). The SDK outputs standard OpenTelemetry trace data compatible with any OpenTelemetry collector or observability backend. Instrumentation is installed via pip and initialized with a single Python call.
title: OpenLLMetry
